svg.title: C05_connectivity
svg.desc: Weak connectivity ignores edge direction only for component membership. Total multidegree counts incoming plus outgoing records; distinct neighbours ignore record multiplicity. Bridge coverage is direct USED_FOR_TREATMENT participation, not efficacy or absence of real-world associations.
